title: Waltair Veerayya
desc: Waltair Veerayya, a fisherman and smuggler, is in dire need of money in order to fight a court case. Later, he is approached by an officer to extradite Solomon Caesar, an infamous drug lord for money.

title: Dashavatar
desc: Two children narrate the story of Lord Vishnu and his ten incarnations who have constantly fought and emerged victorious over any evil that may exist.

title: Hello Guru Preethigoskara
desc: Two friends, Sanju and Anupama, fall in love with each other. However, they don't realise it, until it is too late and Anupama is set to marry someone else.
A gangster deploys two of his trusted men in different cities to extort money from people who have escaped. While on their mission, they find themselves in various adventurous situations.
